tolerance.full: develops with prolonged and repeated use

addictionPotential: moderately addictive with a high potential for abuse
summary: THJ-2201 is an indazole-based synthetic cannabinoid sold online as a designer drug. It is a structural analogue of AM-2201 in which the indole ring is replaced by indazole; it is presumed to act as a potent CB1 receptor agonist.
